title: chrysanthemum atratum var. corsicum
intro: Chrysanthemum atratum var. corsicum, commonly known as Corsican chrysanthemum, is a plant species that belongs to the Asteraceae family. It is known for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional Chinese medicine, where it is used to promote relaxation, reduce stress, and alleviate various health conditions. The plant has been found to have several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as reducing fever, soothing digestive issues, and relieving menstrual cramps. The bioactive constituents of Corsican chrysanthemum include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects and have been used to treat various health conditions, including respiratory and cardiovascular diseases.
